evidence.text: EXPANDING DEMAND ACROSS SEGMENTS; SOLID EXECUTION 2/7 Country Managing Director, Sanjeev Sharma’s commentary on Q3 CY2026 “We delivered a strong third quarter, with record Q3 orders, revenue growth and a healthy backlog reflecting continued customer confidence in ABB’s technology and solutions. Demand remained broadbased across industries, supported by investments in productivity, energy efficiency and sustainable growth. Despite a dynamic operating environment, we maintained our focus on disciplined execution and operational performance. Looking ahead, India’s structural growth drivers in industrialization, electrification, digitalization and the energy transition continue to support attractive growth opportunities, positioning us well for the quarters ahead. I thank our employees for their continued commitment and customer focus.” Outlook ABB India retains strong backlog, which is providing visibility into the coming quarters. Demand trends remain supported by investments in data centers, grid modernization, renewable energy integration and energy-transition projects, alongside ongoing capex plans across metals, cement, rail, buildings. The Company remains focused on successful backlog execution, implementing continuous efficiency measures and disciplined capacity expansions to support a profitable growth momentum. ABB India's local manufacturing base, technology leadership and broad market exposure position it to capture opportunities linked to electrification, automation and industrial digitalization amid a dynamic demand environment.
